title.agentTooOld: The running agent is too old
title.communication: DeckPilot could not talk to the agent
title.pluginsUnavailable: Plugins are not available in the agent
title.platformUnsupported: Plugins cannot run on this platform
title.unknownPlugin: The registry does not offer this plugin or version
title.storeUnavailable: The plugin database cannot be opened
title.invalidState: Not possible in the plugin's current state
title.invalidData: The values do not fit what the plugin declares
title.answerTooLarge: The agent's answer is too large

hint.agentNotRunning: Start the agent in Settings › Background Agent, then try again.
hint.agentTooOld: Restart the agent in Settings › Background Agent so that the agent of this release runs.
hint.pluginsUnavailable: Plugins need an agent built with the `plugins` feature and not started with --disable-plugins.
hint.platformUnsupported: Plugins can be installed and inspected here, but only run where the plugin sandbox is verified: macOS, Linux and Windows.
hint.storeUnavailable: The plugin database cannot be opened with the current key (e.g. after a password change while the agent was locked).
hint.consentRequired: Consent to every permission the plugin declares.
hint.unknownPermission: Reload the plugin; its permissions changed.
hint.registryUnavailable: Check the registry the agent uses, then try again.
hint.revoked: The registry withdrew this version; choose another one or uninstall it.
hint.incompatible: This DeckPilot cannot run it; update DeckPilot or choose another version.
hint.invalidPackage: Only package files whose bytes the verified registry pins can be installed.
hint.unsupportedRuntime: Only WebAssembly plugins (ABI 1) can be installed.
hint.invalidState: Reload the list; the plugin changed in the meantime.
hint.hostFailed: The plugin host failed or is backing off after crashes; try again later.
hint.broken: Its installed files no longer match their record; roll back or uninstall it.
hint.busy: Wait for its running actions to finish, then try again.
hint.requiredBy: Disable the plugins that need it with it, or first.
hint.dependency: The plugin needs plugins or versions that cannot be installed here.
hint.planChanged: Review the new plan and confirm it again.
hint.notBundled: Only plugins that come with DeckPilot can be restored; install others from the marketplace.
hint.notPinned: Install a DeckPilot release that includes it, then restore it.
hint.answerTooLarge: Part of it does not fit one message to the app, even in parts (for instance a plugin's very large settings); ask the plugin's publisher to shorten its manifest.

problem.lineBreaks: A secret cannot contain line breaks.
problem.tooLong: The secret is longer than 16 KiB.

credentials.removeConfirm: Remove the stored {{label}}? The plugin cannot use it afterwards.
credentials.notGranted: Its permission is not granted: a stored secret is not used until you grant it.
credentials.userOrigin: the server in the setting “{{setting}}” once you allow it

missing.title: Required settings are missing
missing.text_one: {{settings}} has no value and no default. The plugin runs without it, and its actions may fail until it is set.
missing.text_other: {{settings}} have no value and no default. The plugin runs without them, and its actions may fail until they are set.

settings.notSecret: Settings are not secret. Never enter a password or token here; the plugin's credentials below are the place for secrets.
settings.unsupported: Settings of kind “{{kind}}” cannot be changed here.

dialog.tooLong: The answer is too long. Shorten the text and try again.

error.lineLength_one: Each line has at most {{count}} character.
error.lineLength_other: Each line has at most {{count}} characters.

consent.askWithSecrets_one: Allow {{plugin}} to send data and your {{secrets}} secret to {{server}}?
consent.askWithSecrets_other: Allow {{plugin}} to send data and your {{secrets}} secrets to {{server}}?
consent.requests: Requests ({{methods}}) go to exactly this server, nowhere else.
consent.requestsPath: Requests ({{methods}}) go to exactly this server and path, nowhere else.
consent.pages: It may also open pages of {{server}} in your browser, in actions you start.

origins.title: Servers you enter
origins.intro: The plugin reaches the server in these settings only after you allow exactly that server. Changing a setting ends its consent; DeckPilot then asks again.
origins.unset: No server is set, so the plugin reaches none through this setting.
origins.invalid: The setting is not a server this plugin can use.
origins.declared: A host the plugin declares, allowed when you installed it.
origins.slotNotGranted: The plugin's permission to connect to a server you enter is not granted. Grant “{{permission}}” first; nothing goes to this server until then.
origins.alsoPrivate: Also allow it on my private network
origins.privateRequired: Required: this is a local name or address.
origins.privateOptional: Only if the server resolves to an address on your network.
origins.neverLocal: This computer and link-local addresses are never reachable.
origins.privateNotAllowed: This server is on a private network, which this plugin's setting does not allow.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.optionalHint: Optional integrations are never installed by themselves; without one, only the actions that use it are unavailable.

moving.label: Moving to a plugin
moving.text: {{module}} is moving to the plugin {{plugin}}. The built-in keeps running its actions until the move is done.

waiting.label: Waiting for your consent
waiting.text: {{module}} can move to the plugin {{plugin}} once you allow what the plugin needs. Until then the built-in keeps running its actions.

unavailable.label: Actions unavailable
unavailable.text: {{module}}'s actions run in {{plugin}}, which is not available: {{reason}}.

moved.label: Moved to a plugin
moved.text: {{module}}'s actions run in the plugin {{plugin}}; your actions keep working unchanged.

failed.textFinal_one: The move to {{plugin}} failed {{count}} time; DeckPilot tries again only when you press Retry. The built-in keeps running its actions.
failed.textFinal_other: The move to {{plugin}} failed {{count}} times; DeckPilot tries again only when you press Retry. The built-in keeps running its actions.
failed.text: The move to {{plugin}} failed; DeckPilot tries again at its next start. The built-in keeps running its actions.

notEligible.text: {{module}} stays built-in on this computer; its actions keep working.

other.label: Unknown state
other.text: The agent reports a state this app does not know; {{module}}'s actions are unchanged.

notice.title: Built-in modules moving to plugins
notice.text: Some built-in modules are replaced by plugins that ship with DeckPilot. Your actions, keys and workflows keep their action types and keep working; nothing is deleted.

origin.label: The server
origin.requestsPath: {{methods}}, to exactly this server and path

dialog.title: {{module}} actions now run as a plugin
dialog.description: The plugin {{plugin}} replaces the built-in {{module}} module. It gets nothing the built-in did not use, and these only with your consent. Until you allow every item, the built-in keeps running your actions.
dialog.declined: {{module}} stays built-in; you can ask again later.
dialog.undecided: {{undecided}} of {{total}} items still need your decision.
dialog.never: Credentials and access to your local network are never granted automatically. Stored credentials stay where they are; the plugin gets a copy in its own slot.

plan.label: Install plan
plan.intro: Review what this plugin may do. Check each permission to consent to it.
plan.introMore_one: It needs {{count}} more plugin, installed first. Each plugin gets only the permissions you grant it here.
plan.introMore_other: It needs {{count}} more plugins, installed first. Each plugin gets only the permissions you grant it here.
plan.checked: Every package was downloaded and checked against the signed registry; nothing is installed before you confirm. If one step fails, what was done is undone.
plan.withoutIt: Without it these actions are unavailable: {{actions}}
plan.blocked: This plan cannot be installed yet
plan.installedOff: Plugins cannot run on this computer: they are installed turned off.

removal.dependents: Other plugins need it. They are turned off with it; nothing else is uninstalled unless you check it below.

configure.title: Configure {{name}}
configure.description: Settings and credentials of version {{version}}, stored by the agent for this plugin only.
configure.credentialsHint: A secret goes to the agent once and is never shown again, here or anywhere. The plugin never sees it: the agent adds it only to requests to the hosts listed.
configure.nothing: This version declares no settings and no credentials.
